-Educational adventure
-Emergency services vehicles
-From: BlockWorks

items.description:
Beep-boop! The robots are here, but which one will you become?

+ 6 HD robot skins
+ Multiple vibrant colors to pick from

items.title: Prince and Princess

items.description:
Put on your crown or tiara and rule the kingdom!

+ 8 HD prince / princess skins
+ Royal clothing
+ Variety of cool styles and colors

items.title: Super Wizards

items.description:
Are you a magic lover? Super Wizards has arrived at the marketplace, now you can be a powerful wizard!

+10 Super Wizards

items.title: Classic Droppers 2
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Are you ready to freefall to your demise over and over again? Do you think you can beat all these awesome dropper levels? Bored and have some free time? Why not give these classic droppers a try? If you dare! 
* 15 classic sky scaring droppers of doom!
* 10 carefree skins included!
* Custom music!
* Custom textures!
By Giggle Block Studios!

items.title: Rich Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Do you want to look like you're rich and famous? Then this modern clothing skin pack is perfect for you! Enjoy unique colorful outfits that are great for a walk around the busy city! These teens are all about the wealthy fashion world. Featuring the newest styles and hottest trends, find your next favorite skin today!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 skins
+ Perfect for teens!

items.title: Penguins
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Love penguins? This pack is perfect for you! Choose one of these adorable penguins and join your penguin loving friends in your world! Grab these penguins today!

+ 10 cute penguin skins
+ Perfect for teens
+ By Withercore

items.title: Candyland Lucky Mobs Skyblock
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Are you ready to spend time in a sweet skyblock island full of candy? Luck is gushing from the animals and candies here! Take control of this beautiful candy filled skyblock and, with the items dropped from mobs, create a beautiful sky utopia!

+ Lucky mobs!
+ Cute chocolate bars that walk!
+ A world full of candy and fun!
+ By Mirevon Studios

items.title: Floral Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Are you looking for something both cute and fresh? If you are, this is the pack for you! In this pack you get 12 unique floral teen skins! These skins include a special skin for 12 different species of flower which are perfect for roleplay. 

+ 12 unique floral teen skins
+ Roleplay friendly, modern flower skins
+ By Pexchxs

items.title: Magical Mermaids
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These magical mermaid skins are so beautiful! Their hair shimmers in the sunlight and they love wearing shells and shiny stones. Mermaids thrive in the sea but can also come up on land if need be!

- 14 mermaid skins

items.title: Anime Rich Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Wear the newest trendy city attire! This anime skin pack is perfect for you! Enjoy unique colorful outfits! These teens are all about the fashion world. Featuring the newest trends like masks and devil horns, find your next favorite skin today!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 skins
+ Beautiful HD designs

items.title: Cute Spring Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Is it just me or has it been getting warmer lately? Spring has finally arrived, and these new skins are bringing the spring colors! With 12 of the cutest modern teen skins out there, we have the outfit that is perfect for your spring fashion style! 

- 12 cute modern teen skins
- Perfect for roleplay!

items.title: Farm 2
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
It's time for some farming and all the fun activities that life brings! There are cute chickens, pigs and cows all over! The farmers love feeding all the animals and watering the plants. Grow your own veggies and sweet fruits here! Nothing beats a visit to the pastures where all the cute little animals await you.

- 11 farm themed skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Superhero Base
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Enter your secret superhero base and choose your superpower! Dig quickly as Mighty Mole. Run fast and shoot fire as Quick Flame. Jump high and throw ninja stars as Ninja Knight.
- Huge city to protect
- Secret base beneath a millionaire mansion
- 4 superhero vehicles with special abilities
- 4 secret base hidden entrances
-4 skins

Be a hero and live in a superhero base!

items.title: Baby Sharks
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Join the baby shark family and start your own ocean adventures, today!

+ 12 baby sharks, creating the cutest aquatic squad!
+ 1 FREE skin included!

items.title: Sci-Fi Mobs
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Look out, the Sci-Fi Mobs just arrived in town!
Believe it or not, the future is now! 

+ 12 Sci-Fi Mobs you're able to play as, in order to take the gaming experience to the next level.
+ All your favourite mobs are here, now improved and representing the future!
+ 1 FREE skin included.

items.title: Millionaire Summer Mansion
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Just like any real millionaire, you must have a summer mansion! Ready to drive the kolf cart to your private golf course? Or do you prefer to drive in a limo? Of course, a real billionaire can also choose to take a sports car or helicopter! Take a look around this fully furnished summer mansion!

+Summer!
+Sport cars!
+Helicopter & Limo!
+Furnished mansion!

items.title: GALAXY CREW

The GALAXY CREW is in orbit! Look stylish with these amazing skins.

By: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Miracle Village
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Long ago, an evil magician invented a curse in his secret laboratory. The curse has strengthened over time, and now the village needs your help... Find weapons at the crystals to keep yourself safe from magical mobs roaming around the village!

- Lightning events every 60 seconds
- 5 magical skins included!
- Licensed by LeadPro and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Power Suits
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Stand out of the crowds with these powerful looking skins! With bright colors hidden behind a dark shell, you will be hard to miss!
